text:
jess: quick q — can we add a 'stagedDefaults' layer to runtime config so product can flip default behaviors for cohorts without a full feature flag?

maria: sounds useful. what's the threat model? race conditions? configs in cache?

jess: main goals: 1) allow safe rollouts of default param changes (e.g., quota cap 500->700) 2) tie to cohort hashing so we can target percent rollout 3) be able to revert fast via console

alex: is this different from temp-overrides? seems like an easier UX for non-feature flag changes.

sam: also need telemetry hooks — if default changes affect routing/quota, we must surface regressions automatically.

jess: yeah. thinking small typed schema:

```
stagedDefaults:
  name: string
  key: string
  default_value: json
  cohort_percent: number
  activation_ts: iso
  ttl: seconds
  rollout_strategy: ["hash","random"]
```

maria: note: cache invalidation is tricky. cache keyed by config_version today. staged defaults would need a version token per cohort or a smart evaluator.

dmitri: agree. implementation idea: evaluate in config-server at read-time -> returns {value, cohort_id, cohort_version} and gateway caches by (key, cohort_version). If cohort_version changes, gateway fetch invalidation event.

alex: that pushes complexity to config-server and event bus. do we have appetite for more bus events? /cc @ops-bot

ops-bot: bonfire:config-event published for `stagedDefaults` changes. subscribers: gateway-cache, telemetry-proxy. Next: schedule at 2026-03-22T15:00Z? :white_check_mark:

sam: telemetry needs a golden set of prompts or metrics to watch. propose metric: p95 latency by cohort, error-rate by cohort, quota-breach count.

jess: also want console UX: list active stagedDefaults, quick rollback (single-click), explain diff vs feature flags, and audit trail.

maria: security question — who can create stagedDefaults? probably only config-admin + sig-off from product. Need an approval annotation field.

dmitri: edge case: overlapping stagedDefaults for same key with different cohorts. How to resolve? last-write-wins? or priority field? prefer deterministic priority field.

alex: also compatibility: older SDKs won't understand stagedDefaults. evaluator should fall back to `default_value` always for SDKs that don't ask for cohort info.

jess: yep. plan: RFC in docs repo, small POC on staging, gating by telemetry alerts + canary cohorts. timeline: POC next week, staging rollouts 2 weeks after, GA after sign-off.

sam: +1 for telemetry gate.

maria: I'll draft the approval flow and console mockups.

jess: thanks all. tagging follow-ups: @maria (approval/console), @dmitri (cache events), @sam (telemetry signals). I'll open RFC PR.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: config-server/poc branch deployed to staging (build 4521). :rocket:

alex: nice, testing now.

jess: (edited) added note about audit retention 90 days. will push PR.
